items.text: Paperbark Wines Careers Cellar Door Host Margaret River WA Casual We're looking for a friendly Cellar Door Host to pour tastings and share the story of our wines on weekends and public holidays. What you'll do Lead tastings for groups of up to twelve, process sales and wine club sign-ups, and keep the tasting room looking its best. About you Hospitality experience and an RSA certificate. A love of wine is a bonus; we will train you. Pay $31 per hour plus weekend penalties. How to apply Send a short note and your resume using the form below. Applications close Sunday 30 November.

Ibis Payments Careers Backend Engineer (Go) Singapore Full-time Apply now Ibis Payments builds the wallet and ledger behind 30,000 merchants in Southeast Asia. Responsibilities Design and run ledger services in Go. Own reliability for the settlement pipeline. Review designs and mentor engineers. Requirements Four years of backend development. Strong knowledge of PostgreSQL and distributed systems. Nice to have Experience with payments or banking. Benefits Hybrid working, medical cover and an annual learning budget. Apply now Share this job Apply now

Northgate Council Work for us Software Developer Position number 2291 Band 6 Permanent full-time Geelong VIC The Digital Services team maintains the systems that residents use to apply for permits, pay rates and book services. In this role you will maintain our planning permit system in C# and SQL Server and help move services to the cloud. Key selection criteria Demonstrated experience developing and supporting business applications. Experience with relational databases. Strong communication skills. Salary $92,500 to $101,300 per annum plus superannuation. To apply, address the key selection criteria in a cover letter and attach your resume. Enquiries to the Digital Services Coordinator.

Gannet Studio Our team We're 18 designers and developers in Auckland making online stores for independent retailers. We're hiring a Frontend Developer. You'll build React and TypeScript storefronts with our designers, write tests, and help us keep our component library tidy. We're after someone with two or more years of React experience who cares about accessibility and fast pages. We pay $95,000 to $110,000 depending on experience, plus a learning budget and a day off for your birthday. Interested? Email us a link to something you've built and a few lines about yourself.

PayReport Insights The 2026 technology salary guide By our research editor 12 minute read Technology salaries rose 4 percent over the year, with the strongest growth in data engineering and security. In this report we break down pay by role and city. Data engineers Senior data engineers in Sydney earned between $160,000 and $190,000. Requirements most often listed in job ads were Spark, dbt and a cloud certification. Security analysts Demand for analysts with a security clearance kept salaries high in Canberra. Methodology We analysed 18,000 job ads published between October 2025 and September 2026. Related reading How to negotiate a pay rise. Download the full report.

Corella Health Life at Corella We're building software that helps clinicians spend more time with patients. Our values Care first, own the outcome, keep it simple. How we work Most of our team works remotely across Australia and we meet in person twice a year. Benefits Eighteen weeks of paid parental leave, a home office budget and an annual wellbeing allowance. Our hiring process An introductory call, a take-home task and a conversation with the team. We aim to give feedback within a week of each stage. We are not hiring for any engineering roles right now, but you can register your interest and we will contact you when a role opens.
